stem: 在以下哪种情形中,应认定客户拥有过于复杂的股权结构？

options.A: 一家由两个个人持有的私人公司,其权益由一系列信托和基金会持有
options.B: 由两名受托人共同设立的信托,其中一名受托人为委托人,另一名为公司服务提供商
options.C: 一个由两个家族共同拥有的客户,涉及家族内部十几位所有者
options.D: 一家跨国代理银行,其与一家上市银行控股公司之间存在三层所有权关系

stem_en: In which of the following scenarios should the customer be deemed to have an overly complex ownership structure?

options_en.A: A privately held company owned by two individuals whose interests are held by a series of trusts and foundations
options_en.B: A trust set up with two co-trustees, one of whom is the grantor and the other is a corporate service provider
options_en.C: A customer that is owned by two families with the involvement of over a dozen owners within the families
options_en.D: A multinational correspondent bank that has three layers of ownership between it and a publicly traded bank holding company
